text: How to shield yourself spiritually so nothing follows you home. Spiritual attacks don't always feel like a punch. Sometimes they feel like exhaustion that never lifts, like anxiety in sacred places, like a presence watching you in mirrors that never show anything there. These are not random. They're echoes, energies that aren't yours trying to make a home in your body. To shield yourself, You must create a boundary that's invisible to the eye, but impenetrable to the unseen. Begin just before sunrise, the hour where night's influence fades, but the sun hasn't fully arrived. Stand barefoot on ground, not floor. Salt a ring around where you stand and close your eyes. Breathe in slowly, as if you're pulling light from beneath the earth into your lungs. Now speak. I am not open. I am not prey. What is mine returns to me. What is not leaves me. Repeat until you feel the air shift. Not colder, not warmer, just lighter. Then imagine your body coated in a film of molten gold. Thin, quiet, sacred. That's your armor now. But be warned, spiritual shields fade. They don't crack. They dissolve from neglect. When you stop cleansing, when you stop believing, when you open your energy to everything that whispers your name, the shield becomes paper. That's why The Grimoire of Withered Echoes holds rituals to reinforce the barrier, especially after rituals near cemeteries or after visiting haunted spaces. It teaches you how to protect your dreams, your aura, and even the people you live with. You'll find it in my profile or my story, because it's not enough to close a door. You have to make sure nothing has a key.
